qa_pairs.question: What kind of filesystem information can Alliance users find in the User portal tab of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Alliance users can find their quotas for the filesystems under the User portal tab of the Metrix portal.

qa_pairs.question: What job-related information is available to Alliance users in the User portal tab of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The User portal tab displays an Alliance user's 10 last jobs. Users can select a job by its number to view details.

qa_pairs.question: How can an Alliance user access a full list of all their jobs from the User portal tab in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: By clicking on "(More details)" in the User portal tab, Alliance users are redirected to the Job statistics tab, where all their jobs are listed.
